text: {"question":"How did the statistical significance of evidence for late‑time dark‑energy dynamics change between the earlier and later studies?","reference_answer":"The earlier analysis reported a 3–4σ preference for an evolving equation of state that crosses into the phantom regime, which was reduced to just over 2σ when using a more standard vanilla model. The later work, employing generalized PAge parameterizations, found that these models are strongly favored over ΛCDM and can alleviate the Hubble tension, indicating a shift toward stronger support for late‑time modifications."}
